items.image: images/Chicago Skyline A Fluid Transcription,7x 79 in,Ink and watercolor on rice paper,2025.jpg
items.title: Chicago Skyline: A Fluid Transcription | 芝加哥：流墨长卷
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Ink and watercolor on rice paper (Scroll)  Size: 7 x 79 in
items.description:
远望城市时，建筑的轮廓总与光线、空气和个人的感受交织。我以水色的渗化松动天际线的几何秩序，保留芝加哥冷冽而流动的气息。长卷让观看沿着时间展开，一处景象尚未消退，另一处已进入视野。城市由此成为一段持续变化的印象，也成为记忆与当下感受相遇的地方。

Seen from a distance, a city takes shape through architecture, light, atmosphere, and personal feeling. I use spreading washes to loosen the geometry of Chicago's skyline and retain its cool, shifting atmosphere. The scroll unfolds through time: one view enters before another has fully faded. The city becomes an evolving impression, a place where memory meets the experience of the present.

items.image: images/The Subconscious River,128x11 in,Ink&mixed media on paper,2025.jpg
items.title: The Subconscious River | 潜意识之河
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Ink and mixed media on paper (Scroll) / 纸本水墨与综合材料 (长卷)  Size: 128x11 in
items.description:
Thoughts and feelings often leave traces before they are fully understood. Through the gathering, pauses, and spread of ink, I approach a movement that resists being planned in advance. The scroll extends the duration of looking, bringing density and openness, control and chance into a changing sequence. Feelings accumulate and turn in new directions, suggesting an inward journey without a fixed beginning or end.

思绪与情绪常在尚未被理解之前，已经留下痕迹。我以水墨的聚散、停顿和蔓延，接近这种难以预先安排的流动。长卷延长了观看的过程，让密集与空白、控制与偶然依次展开。感受在其中积聚，也在转折处改变方向，形成一段没有固定起止的内在历程。

items.title: Time | 时间
items.meta: 2026,28x50in,Oil on canvas
items.description:
Time unfolds according to an inward rhythm. Experiences may pass while their emotional traces remain in memory; brief moments can continue to shape a life. Between order, pause, and drift, thoughts gather, change direction, and persist. I am interested in how an individual lives through this kind of time, retaining an inner life whose rhythm is not entirely determined by the outside world.

时间沿着内心的节奏展开。有些经历已经过去，感受却仍在记忆中停留；有些片刻短暂，却久久改变着生命的节律。在秩序、停顿与游移之间，思绪不断积聚、转向和延续。我关注个体如何经历这样的时间，并保留一份不被外部节奏同化的内在生活。

items.title: Cold Mountain | 冷山
items.meta: 2026,14x14in,,Oil on canvas
items.description:
In solitude, even familiar surroundings can feel remote. An inward coldness changes how the world feels, bringing external stillness and private emotion together. Through the image of a mountain, I consider how we experience a place while bringing our own feelings into it. The mountain's silence becomes a state of mind.

独处时，熟悉的世界也会显得遥远。内心的冷意悄然改变着环境的触感，使外部的寂静与个人的感受逐渐交融。我在山的形象中寻找这种难以划分的关系：人感受着所处之地，也将自己的情绪带入其中。山的静默由此成为一种心境。

items.title: The White Veil | 白色面纱
items.meta: Year: 2024 Medium: Oil on canvas Size: 36 x 24 in
items.description:
Cultural experience accompanies an individual into new surroundings, changing in meaning along the way. Through the veil, I consider the connection and protection it can offer: memories of the past remain close to the body while preserving a private space that need not be fully exposed. Concealment and visibility coexist, suggesting a cultural identity that remains private and open to change.

文化经验伴随个体进入不同的环境，也在这一过程中改变着意义。我借面纱思考它所带来的联系与保护：过去的记忆仍然贴近身体，同时为个人保留一处不必完全显露的空间。遮蔽与显露在画中并存，也使文化身份呈现出私密而流动的一面。

items.title: Street I / II | 街道 I / II
items.meta: 2026,8x10in,Oil on canvas
items.description:
Familiar routes shift in memory, and everyday surroundings lose their former certainty. A place can remain recognizable while no longer feeling close. These two paintings attend to the psychological distance that can arise within a familiar setting, allowing wandering thoughts and unresolved hesitations to enter its space. A heightened awareness accompanies solitude, unsettling the sense of belonging once taken for granted.

熟悉的路径在记忆中发生错位，日常环境逐渐失去原有的确定感。人仍能辨认这些地方，却难以恢复曾经的亲近。两件作品关注身处熟悉之地时产生的心理距离，让游移的思绪与未尽的迟疑进入空间。清醒与孤独相伴，使日常的归属感变得不再理所当然。

items.title: Gossamer | 游丝
items.meta: 2026,20x16in,Acrylicon fabric
items.description:
Feeling reaches outward like gossamer, seeking connection and response. Delicate and vulnerable, it retains a desire to draw close to the world. I am interested in this tentative attachment: a bond is not yet secure, an answer may not arrive, and still the movement outward continues. Even at the edge of dissolution, a quiet desire for connection remains.

感知像游丝一样向外伸展，寻找可以依附和回应的联系。它轻微、脆弱，却保留着靠近世界的愿望。我关注这种试探中的牵系：关系尚未稳固，回应也未必到来，向外探出的动作仍在继续。生命在可能消散的边缘，保持着一份细小而真实的眷恋。

items.title: A Fractured Inner Landscape | 碎裂的内景
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 12 x 12 in
items.description:
Inner unease can make a stable space feel unfamiliar. An architectural order remains recognizable, but shifting forms disturb its coherence and weaken the certainty of the setting. I allow feeling to enter the organization of space, bringing external reality and psychological experience into contact. The person inhabiting it may remain in place, while the relationships that once made the surroundings familiar have changed.

内心的不安使原本稳定的空间变得陌生。建筑的秩序仍然可辨，却逐渐受到游移形态的干扰，熟悉的环境也因此失去确定感。我让内在感受进入空间的组织之中，呈现现实与心理经验相互交叠的状态。人仍身处其中，周围的一切却已不再保持原来的关系。

items.title: The Dance of Withering and Blooming | 起舞的枯荣
items.meta: 2026,10x8in,Acrylic and airbrush on fabric
items.description:
Vulnerability and vitality are intertwined, as pain and longing arise together. Life retains an impulse to reach outward even in decline, while growth remains open to injury. I understand withering and blooming as interwoven processes, sharing a single movement. The work holds both this struggle and the attachment to being alive that persists within uncertainty.

脆弱与生机彼此牵引，痛楚也与渴望同时发生。生命在衰败中仍保有向外伸展的力量，而生长始终带着受伤的可能。我将枯与荣视为相互交织的过程，感受它们在同一种律动中共存。作品承载着挣扎，也承载着生命在不安之中对存在的眷恋。

items.title: The Subtle Quiver | 幽微的轻颤
items.meta: 2026,8x10in,Acrylic and airbrush on fabric
items.description:
The slightest touch can set off a quiet but unmistakable tremor. The body may respond before a feeling finds words. I want to hold this moment of emergence: subtle and sensitive, not yet clearly understood, but already changing the experience of the present. The work attends to inward changes that can be difficult to notice even as they make themselves felt.

微小的触碰也会在内心引起真实的轻颤。某些感受尚未来得及被说出，身体已经作出回应。我希望留住这种感受初生的片刻：它细微、敏锐，还没有形成清楚的意义，却已改变了当下的经验。作品关注那些不易察觉、又切实存在的内在变化。

items.title: Reflection | 映像
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 18 x 24 in
items.description:
A familiar face can suddenly seem strange, even when it is our own. In this painting, I consider how a sense of self emerges through looking and becomes uncertain in the same encounter. The intensity of red and the weight of the brushwork heighten the pressure of the gaze. Familiarity and distance coexist, making the act of looking at oneself a tentative search for recognition.

熟悉的面孔也可能突然显得陌生，连自己的形象也不例外。我在这幅画中追问，自我如何在观看中被辨认，又如何变得难以确定。强烈的红色与厚重的笔触，加深了凝视带来的压迫感。亲近与疏离同时存在，观看自己的过程也因此成为一次迟疑的确认。

items.title: Sensory Wash | 漫流
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 20 x 28 in
items.description:
Sound, water, and emotion seem to wash over the body, loosening the boundary between inner and outer worlds. I bring the figure into contact with flowing lines to evoke a state of immersion in which defenses soften. The body retains its form while opening to its surroundings. Perception takes shape through this exchange, connecting an individual to the world beyond the skin.

声音、水流与情绪仿佛漫过身体，使内外之间的界限逐渐松动。我将具象的人物与流动的线条相叠，呈现一种放下防备、沉浸其中的状态。身体依然保有自身的形态，却向周围的世界敞开。感知就在这种相互渗透中发生，人与环境也由此建立联系。

items.title: The Feline Spirit | 猫之灵
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size:18 x 24 in
items.description:
A familiar image can retain a distinctive sense of life as it is broken apart and reassembled. I translate the feline form into related areas of color and texture, allowing separate parts to gather into a whole through the act of looking. Recognition and unfamiliarity occur together, holding the image between stability and change. The painting considers how a living presence can remain perceptible as its form is transformed.

熟悉的形象经过分解与重组，仍能保留独特的生命感。我将猫的形态转化为彼此关联的色块与肌理，让局部在观看中重新聚成整体。辨认与陌生感由此同时发生，形象也在确定与游移之间保持张力。作品关注形态如何改变，以及我们如何在变化之中依然感到一个生命的存在。

items.title: The Golden Boundary | 金色边界
items.meta: **Year:** 2025  **Medium:** Oil on canvas  **Size:** 18 x 22 in
items.description:
A beautiful surface attracts attention while sometimes obscuring the complexity of a person's experience. I bring the body into contact with decorative pattern to consider how an individual retains a presence within a constructed image. The interplay of flat pattern and bodily presence moves the viewer between closeness and distance. As an outward image becomes more complete, how much of the life within it can still be felt?

美丽的表面吸引目光，也可能遮蔽一个人的复杂感受。我让身体与装饰性图案相遇，关注个体如何在被呈现的形象中保留自身。平面的秩序与身体的存在感彼此牵动，使观看在亲近与距离之间移动。作品追问，当外表越来越完整时，我们还能感受到其中多少真实的生命。

items.title: Sunlit Ripples | 阳光下的涟漪
items.meta: **Year:** 2024  **Medium:** Oil on canvas  **Size:** 16 x 20 in
items.description:
Light and the movement of water give an ordinary scene a changing vitality. I use saturated color and thickly applied paint to intensify this direct sensory experience, giving a familiar waterscape an expansive energy. The painting holds the moment of being moved by color in nature and a desire to find a fullness of life within everyday surroundings.

光照与水的流动，让平常的景物显出不断变化的活力。我以饱和的色彩和厚重的笔触，强化这种直接的感官经验，使熟悉的水景充满向外生长的力量。作品保留着观看自然时被色彩触动的瞬间，也表达了从日常事物中感受生命充盈的愿望。

items.title: Internal Bloom | 内在绽放
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 36 x 24 in
items.description:
The body's interior sustains life and holds feelings that can be difficult to share. By bringing what is usually concealed into view, I consider the relationship between protection and exposure. Vulnerability carries a double meaning: it marks where injury is possible while remaining closely bound to what keeps us alive. The painting considers how opening oneself can reveal pain and strength together.

身体内部维系着生命，也承载着难以向他人说明的感受。我让原本被遮蔽的内部显露出来，使保护与暴露之间的关系变得可见。脆弱因而带有双重意味：它既是可能受伤的地方，也与生命的持续紧密相连。作品关注人在敞开自身时，如何同时显露痛楚与力量。

items.title: Through the Lens | 透过镜头
items.meta: Year: 2022 Medium:wooden board, acrylic, water color, rice paper Size 18*22in
items.description:
When we encounter the world online, we often see images that have been selected and altered. They influence our judgments and can encourage acceptance before reflection. Taking the lens as a starting point, I consider both the view an image provides and the limits of that view. The work asks us to question what we see and to remain engaged with things and experiences beyond the image.

当我们通过网络认识世界，接触到的往往是经过选择与修饰的图像。这些图像影响着判断，也容易让人未经思考便选择相信。我以镜头为出发点，关注图像所提供的视野及其边界。作品提醒我们在相信所见之前保持辨别，并继续接触图像之外的事物与经验。

items.title: Knot | 结
items.meta: Year: 2022 Medium ink, watercolor, rice paper Size 20in*24in
items.description:
My training in Chinese calligraphy has shaped my sense of line and rhythm. I combine ink and watercolor, bringing flowing and rough marks, wet and dry passages into contact. Their differences suggest a relationship informed by yin and yang: contrasting qualities act upon one another while contributing to a whole. The work seeks connections between different approaches to painting, preserving the tension of their encounter.

书法训练影响了我对线条与节奏的感受。我将水墨与水彩结合，让流动与粗粝、润泽与干涩的笔触在同一画面中相遇。这些差异使我联想到阴阳相依的关系：相反的质感彼此牵动，也共同构成整体。作品尝试在不同的绘画经验之间建立联系，保留它们相遇时的张力。

items.title: Turn a Blind Eye | 睁一只眼闭一只眼
items.meta: Year: 2022 Medium magazine collage Size 14*17in
items.description:
An attraction to wealth and prosperity can coexist with indifference to the suffering of others. Drawing on the idea of turning a blind eye, I question how we choose which realities to acknowledge. The collage places different circumstances alongside one another, bringing responsibility into the act of looking. When we deliberately look away from harm, our indifference may allow it to persist.

人们对财富与繁荣的向往，有时伴随着对他人困境的漠视。我借"睁一只眼闭一只眼"这句俗语，追问我们如何选择自己愿意看见的现实。拼贴将不同处境并置，让观看本身显出责任：当我们有意回避本应被阻止的事情，冷漠也可能成为纵容其继续发生的力量。

items.title: Temperatures of Feeling | 心绪的温度
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Oil on canvas (Triptych) / 布面油画 (三联画)  Size: 11x14 in,8x10 in,9x12in
items.description:
Emotion is not always legible in a facial expression, yet it can change how a person is seen and approached. I use the warmth and coolness of color, together with the force of the brushwork, to convey feelings beyond outward appearance. Each portrait holds a different emotional intensity, brought into relation through their grouping. Temperature becomes a metaphor for distinctions in feeling that are difficult to put into words.

情绪并不总能通过表情被准确辨认，却会改变一个人被观看、被接近的方式。我借色彩的冷暖和笔触的力度，寻找面容之外的感受。三幅肖像各自保有不同的情绪强度，也在并置中彼此映照。"温度"在这里成为一种比喻，让难以言明的心绪在冷暖之间变得可感。

items.title: Uncanny Spaces | 暗影疏离
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Oil on canvas (Triptych)  Size: 8 x 12 in (each panel)
items.description:
Everyday spaces carry a sense of familiarity, yet they can become unsettling in solitude. Across this triptych, small disturbances enter ordinary architectural settings, making their apparent safety uncertain. A face in a mirror or a hand reaching into view interrupts the stillness. Fear develops between what is seen and what is imagined, as inner estrangement begins to alter the character of the surroundings.

日常空间承载着熟悉感，也可能在独处时显出异样。这组三联画让细微的不安进入平常的建筑环境，使原有的安全感变得不再确定。镜中的面孔、窗边伸出的手，打断了空间的寂静。恐惧在所见与所想之间生成，内心的疏离也悄然改变着环境的面貌。

items.title: Walking Shells | 行走的躯壳
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 10 x 30 in
items.description:
This painting begins with Magdalena Abakanowicz's sculpture Agora in Chicago's Grant Park and considers how an individual can be recognized within a crowd. I alter the colors and surfaces of the torsos, allowing similar outlines to suggest different states of being. Without faces, distinctions remain, while proximity does not necessarily create connection. The work attends to isolation within a group and the possibility of retaining an individual presence.

这幅画以 Magdalena Abakanowicz 位于芝加哥格兰特公园的雕塑《Agora》为出发点，思考个体如何在群体中被辨认。我通过改变躯干的色彩与表面，使相近的身体轮廓显出不同的状态。失去面孔之后，差异依然存在，而彼此靠近也未必意味着建立了联系。作品关注共处之中的孤立，以及个体保留自身特征的可能。

items.title: Staged Memory | 记忆上演
items.meta: **Year:** 2024 **Medium:** Oil on canvas **Size:** 22 x 28 in
items.description:
A familiar culture can gradually become something observed from a distance. An individual remains connected to past experience without always being able to inhabit it. Through the theater, I consider the distance between participation and spectatorship, allowing cultural memory to become unfamiliar in the act of being staged. The painting attends to the shifting position of someone shaped by an experience who now sees it from elsewhere.

熟悉的文化也可能逐渐成为被观看的对象。个体与过去的经验保持联系，却未必始终能够置身其中。我借剧场思考参与与旁观之间的距离，让文化记忆在上演的同时显出陌生感。作品关注人在回望自身经验时的游移：既被它塑造，又开始从另一个位置观看它。

items.title: Medical Astrology: The Hidden Flame | 内纹星图：暗焰
items.meta: Year: 2025  Title: : Ink on tracing paper, digital prints, lightbox  Size: 8.5 x 11 in (each)
items.description:
Drawing on symbolic correspondences between zodiac signs and bodily organs, I imagine a constellation beneath the skin. Images of skin, organs, and tattoo-like patterns overlap within the lightboxes. When illuminated, concealed forms become visible, changing how the body is perceived. This movement between concealment and revelation opens a space for imagining an inner life: the spirit, feeling, and strength of a person that appearance alone cannot disclose.

我借星座与身体器官之间的象征性对应，想象一幅藏在皮肤之下的星图。皮肤、器官与纹样在层叠的图像中彼此关联，随着灯光开启，原本隐去的形象逐渐显现。光改变了身体被观看的方式，也引出对内在生命的想象：一个人的精神、感受与力量，如何超出外表所能透露的部分。

items.title: Pure Energy | 纯粹能量
items.meta: Year: 2026  Medium: Ink on paper / 纸本水墨  Size: 27 x 27 in
items.description:
I turn to the structure of bone to explore an inward rhythm of life. As the body's outer appearance is pared back, the bending, extending lines retain a sense of movement. Changes in the density and spacing of ink allow a finite form to suggest a continuing flow of energy. The work considers how life can still be felt when the body is no longer presented as a complete figure.

我借骨骼的结构探寻生命内在的节律。身体的外部形貌被简化，曲折延展的线条仍让人感到一种持续的运动。水墨的浓淡与疏密，使有限的形体显出流动的力量。作品停留在有形与无形之间，追问当完整的身体退去之后，生命还会以怎样的方式被感受到。

items.title: Spirit Feather | 灵羽
items.meta: 2026,Medium: Ceramic sculpture / 陶瓷雕塑,Size: 16 x 9 x 9 in
items.description:
This goddess embodies my own life force. I bring the lightness of feathers and the energy of flame into a human form, expressing a desire to grow upward and move freely. In ceramic, these dynamic qualities become part of a still body, giving inner strength a visible presence. The work continues my exploration of the human body and the supernatural, expressing a desire for life to keep unfolding outward.

这位神女代表着我自身的生命力。我将羽的轻盈与火的力量融入人的形体，寄托向上生长、自由舒展的愿望。陶瓷使这些流动的意象凝聚在一个静止的身体中，让内在的精神力量获得可见的形象。作品延续了我对身体与超自然生命的想象，也表达了生命不断向外展开的渴望。

items.image: images/The Book of Nightmares,8x6x0.6 in,Ink on paper, thread, pop-up book,2024.jpg
items.title: The Book of Nightmares | 噩梦之书
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Ink on paper, thread, pop-up book / 纸本水墨，线，立体书  Size: 21 x 15 x 1.5 cm (Closed)
items.description:
I imagine the passage from birth through death and into reincarnation as a dream spanning an entire existence. Through encounters and entanglements with the world, a person develops a sense of self while experiencing fear, struggle, and loss. Turning the pages unfolds this journey, linking the end of one life to an unknown beginning. The fear of ceasing to exist remains intertwined with the longing to continue.

我将人从出生、经历死亡到灵魂转世的历程，化为一场贯穿生命的梦。人在与世界的纠缠中逐渐认识自身，也经历恐惧、挣扎与失去。书页的翻动让这段历程逐步展开，生命的终点又连接着未知的起点。对消逝的恐惧与对存在的眷恋，在这一轮回中始终交织。

items.meta: Year: 2022 Medium glass, clay, acrylic, yarn,glitter Size 20*15*15in
items.title: Light Up | 点亮
items.description:
When I first moved to Canada, I felt lonely and helpless. The friendships I gradually formed brought warmth and connection. I use glass, which allows us to see through it while keeping us apart, to express the invisible distance between people. Seeing one another does not ensure closeness; understanding and companionship help bridge that distance. The work reflects my hope that comfort and kindness can bring light into someone's life at a difficult moment.

初到加拿大时，我曾感到孤独与无助；朋友的靠近逐渐带来了温暖。我用透明却无法轻易穿越的玻璃，表达人与人之间无形的距离。彼此可以看见，内心却仍需要理解与陪伴才能靠近。作品寄托着对善意的期待：在他人低落或受困时，一次安慰、一次帮助，都可能点亮一个人的内心。

items.meta: Year: 2024 Medium: Digital photograph / Self-Portrait Size: 16:9
items.title: Self-Portrait: The Chrysalis of Shadow | 自画像：影之蛹
items.description:
Through a mythic image of myself, I consider the movement between concealment and emergence. Darkness holds what is not yet understood and leaves room for a gradual transformation. Light around the body suspends this change on the verge of happening, carrying both a desire to become and hesitation before the unknown. The self-portrait considers how an individual accepts complexity and lives with a self that is still taking shape.

我借带有神话意味的自我形象，感受隐蔽与显现之间的变化。黑暗容纳了尚未被理解的部分，也为缓慢的转化留下空间。身体周围的光使这种变化保持在将要发生的时刻，既有蜕变的愿望，也有对未知的迟疑。这幅自画像关注个体如何接纳自身的复杂，并与仍在形成的自我相处。

items.title: Iron and White | 铁与白
items.description:
The meeting of softness and hardness brings bodily vulnerability and agency into view together. I am interested in a relationship with the surroundings that involves both constraint and support. White fabric contrasts with a dark structure, while the body's posture keeps that relationship unresolved. The photograph rests between reliance and resistance, considering how an individual retains a position and a will of their own within given conditions.

柔软与坚硬的并置，使身体的脆弱和主动性同时显现。我关注人物与环境之间既受限制、又相互支撑的关系。白色织物与深色结构形成对照，身体的姿态则使这种关系保持开放。作品停留在依靠与抵抗之间，思考个体如何在既定条件中保留自己的位置与意志。
items.meta: Year: 2024 Medium: Digital photograph
Year: 2023 Medium: Digital photograph
items.title: Night Drift | 夜之漂流
items.description:
A person can remain inwardly distant while standing among the lights of a city. The surroundings continue to move, while private feeling follows another rhythm. Through the relationship of light and darkness around the figure, I hold this state of being present yet partly elsewhere. The photograph attends to the need for personal space within a public setting, and to an inner life that the activity outside cannot fully reach.

置身城市的灯光之中，内心仍可能保持距离。环境持续流动，个人的感受却未必与它同步。我借人物与夜色之间的明暗关系，保留这种身处其中、又有所游离的状态。作品关注人在公共环境中对私人空间的需要，以及外界的热闹无法完全触及的那部分内心。

items.title: Chromium Covenant | 铬之契约
items.description:
I bring a figure with a futuristic appearance into a classical architectural setting to consider how a contemporary individual encounters inherited historical narratives. Differences between clothing, posture, and space allow contrasting senses of time to meet within one image. The figure claims a place at the center, suggesting an identity that can be actively shaped. The work considers how an individual establishes a position within a space charged with historical meaning.

我让带有未来感的形象进入古典建筑的环境，思考当代个体如何面对既有的历史叙事。服饰、姿态与空间之间的差异，使不同的时间感在同一画面中相遇。人物主动占据观看的中心，也让身份呈现为可以重新塑造的形象。作品关注个体如何在承载历史象征的空间中，确立自身的位置。

items.title: The Liquid Threshold | 水的边界
items.meta: Year: 2023 Medium: Digital photograph
items.description:
A transparent surface brings the underwater world close to view while keeping it beyond direct reach. I am interested in the coexistence of visual intimacy and physical separation. Light from the underwater scene falls across the figure, creating a sense of connection while the barrier remains. Through the aquarium's viewing space, the work considers how we approach nature and why that proximity continues to involve distance.

透明的界面让水中世界近在眼前，却依然无法直接触及。我关注这种视觉亲近与实际分隔同时存在的经验。水域一侧的光线延伸到人物身上，使观看者与被观看的环境产生联系，边界本身却仍然存在。作品借水族馆的观景空间，思考人如何接近自然，以及这种接近为何始终带着距离。
